definitions.gloss: rate of increase; rate of rise
definitions.explanation: How much a figure has gone up, expressed as a percentage of its earlier value. Used of prices, wages, temperatures, and stock indexes.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}の{上昇率|じょうしょうりつ}は{三|さん}パーセントだった。
examples.english: This year's rate of increase was three percent.

examples.japanese: {物価|ぶっか}の{上昇率|じょうしょうりつ}が{賃金|ちんぎん}を{上回|うわまわ}っている。
examples.english: The rate of price increases is outpacing wages.

examples.japanese: {地価|ちか}の{上昇率|じょうしょうりつ}は{地域|ちいき}によって{大|おお}きく{違|ちが}い、{都心|としん}では{十|じゅう}パーセントを{超|こ}えた{場所|ばしょ}もある。
examples.english: The rate of land price increases differs greatly by area, and in the city center there are places where it exceeded ten percent.

notes:
{上昇|じょうしょう} (rise, ascent) + {率|りつ} (rate, ratio). Standard vocabulary in economic news, where it is usually compared with the same month or year before.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {物価|ぶっか}の{上昇率|じょうしょうりつ}: the rate of price increases
- {上昇率|じょうしょうりつ}が{高|たか}い: to have a high rate of increase
- {前年比|ぜんねんひ}の{上昇率|じょうしょうりつ}: the year-on-year rate of increase

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {下落率|げらくりつ}: rate of decline — the opposite, used of prices and markets
- {伸|の}び{率|りつ}: growth rate — everyday and positive in tone, used of sales and numbers of users
